title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade moved to Saturday due to projected storm | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

For the first time in its history, the iconicMacy’s Thanksgiving Day Paradehas been postponed because of forecasted heavy rain and strong winds.

Strong to damaging winds, along with moderate to heavy rainfall, are expected across the region during the holiday, according to theNational Weather Service.

The parade will now begin at 8:30 a.m. ET Saturday.

The rescheduling marks the first time the event’s been postponed, though the parade was suspended from 1942 to 1944during World War II.

The decision was made after consultation with the city, Macy’s said in a statement.

New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani will not attend Saturday’s parade because of ascheduled foot surgery, he said during a news conference Wednesday.

“I will not be able to make it because of the doctor’s orders,” the mayor said.

Postponing the parade requires a massive logistical shift involving law enforcement and city agencies, along with Macy’s employees and volunteers who make the event happen.

The parade balloons will be deflated Wednesday night, returned to a facility in New Jersey and re-inflated on Friday afternoon, Will Coss, the executive producer of the parade, said.

Macy’s is “heartbroken” over the postponement, Coss said.

He said the company was still working through logistics to keep the same bands and teams, some of whom traveled across the country to march, in the parade for Saturday.

Mamdani stressed that while New Yorkers and “millions around the world” were looking forward to the parade on Thanksgiving Day, safety is a priority for the event.

Winds will begin picking up in the area steadily Wednesday into early Thursday, with gusts nearing 40 mph by 8 a.m. ET.

Widespread steady rain will move in by noon Thursday, when gusts will approach 50 mph. The rain and wind will progressively weaken overnight Thursday into very early hours Friday.

In Philadelphia, organizers decided to cancel the Thanksgiving Day parade – which is billed as theoldest in the nation– after first announcing they wouldground balloons.

Strong winds spoiled the debut of a balloon based on the children’s book “Where the Wild Things Are” during the1998 parade. The balloon ended up with a 10-foot gash in its side and had to be removed from the event. The year prior, a woman was seriously injured by falling debris when a Cat in the Hat balloon was pushed by a wind gust into a lamp post.

The firstMacy’s Thanksgiving Day Paradedebuted in 1924 as a Christmas parade.

This story has been updated with additional information.

CNN’s Sarah Boxer, Gloria Pazmino, Maria Aguilar, Matthew Mochow and meteorologist Tyler Ory contributed to this report.
